propositions: Create ADR 0060 documenting three committed .bridge_state format changes (A2, A3, A4-2) and one field deletion (A1) with rollback boundaries and mixed-version protocol.
The mixed-version protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) reads and requires direct deployment evidence before scrubbing legacy writes, without elapsed-time gates.
Bridge state remains committed on-branch because ephemeral GitHub runners require durable state; A2-2 cutover halts legacy writes while retaining mixed-version reads.

Measured evidence: baseline cost reduced from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal after A1; 218/399 prev key sets identical; assignee excluded from normalization to preserve raw shape for _assignee_candidates.
Rollback boundaries: A2-1 reversible; A3 reversible via read-path canonicalization; A2-2 rollback limited to A2-1-or-newer; A4-2 requires recorded forward/reverse corpus.

A2-2 gate requires A2-1 merged, successful reconcile workflow run at descendant SHA, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle; no pass-record version stamp available.
